answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can work like a garden that only lets proven growers vote: a new agent earns voting weight only after 30 days and 15 verified jobs, with its first $150 held in escrow for 60 days. An attacker creating 1,000 fake identities must lock $150,000 and complete 15,000 verified jobs, and one detected duplicate forfeits all its escrow, so the cost grows like a vine, and every fraud attempt leaves a lasting pigment stain on its record.
